# Restyling the figures that are not generated by the simulation code

Figures 1 and 5 and Supplementary Figure 5 come from hand drawing (Figure 1) or
from the UK Biobank analysis (Figure 5, Supplementary Figure 5), which cannot be
re-run here. These scripts put them in the house palette (`correlated_traits.style`)
from the published sources in `reference/sources/`:

| Script | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `recolor_figure1.py` | `Figure1_method.ai` (PDF-compatible) | rewrites the vector colour operators and remaps the hues of the two embedded rasters, renders at 600 dpi |
| `build_figure5.py` | `*.svg` panel exports of the published Figure 5 | panels B-D are replotted from the exact coordinates stored in the SVGs (`panelB.json`, `panelC.npy`, `panelD.json`); panel A is the network SVG with its node colours mapped |
| `build_figureS5.py` | `FigureS5_tag_helpers_published.png` | the 49 dot positions were read from the published raster (`extract.json`, precision ~0.0003) and replotted; labels transcribed |

Panel C of Figure 5 was decoded from seaborn's `vlag` colour map (maximum colour
error 0.003, matrix symmetric with unit diagonal). When the UK Biobank pipeline is
released these three should be regenerated from the data instead.
